motion: Two independent 3D label surfaces with perspective changes, rendered in Blender
tracker: OpenCV SIFT features, ratio test, RANSAC homography and five-frame temporal median; no ground-truth transforms used for placement
occlusion: Own opaque foreground beam. Mask computed from own source geometry, analogous to supplied holdout/rotoscope; not proof of automatic mask extraction from arbitrary client footage.
sample_status: Own controlled test; not client footage, no commercial case, no promise that 16 client shots can be automatically processed.
client_scope: Approx.16 shots,2–10sec each, two logos, perspective and occlusion. Each client shot requires manual review and masks as needed.
